registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Form is active.

minimal.title: Multiselect Question with options
minimal.description: A question with its option blocks, in a Fair Form.

syntheticIds.formId: A UUID identifying this form within the post (submissions are grouped by it). Generate a fresh UUID (v4) per Fair Form block; the editor replaces a missing or duplicated one.

categories.title: Multiselect Question with subcategory choices
categories.description: Every subcategory (at any depth) of one parent category is a choice.

syntheticIds.formId: A UUID identifying this form within the post (submissions are grouped by it). Generate a fresh UUID (v4) per Fair Form block; the editor replaces a missing or duplicated one.
syntheticIds.parentCategoryId: The term ID of an existing post category whose subcategories become the choices. With a missing or deleted category the question renders without choices.
